question: PROJ-42: accept this bug as M, R1?
headline: A cover message about an invoice adds a false refund request next to the delivery one

recommendation.label: Accept as M, R1
recommendation.meaning: the main claim has evidence; the gaps are listed
recommendation.why: Reproduced on the live model: each page of a document goes to its own model call with the same cover message, so the call for the returns page does not see the delivery page and reads 'invoice' as a refund. Fix it at the input, not with a filter afterwards.

checks.text: Two-page document, message 'invoice and return form attached': false refund in 3 of 3 runs
The message from the request itself: 1 of 3 runs
Control, delivery page only: 0 of 3 runs

notVerified: I did not open the real cases from the request: the log viewer is not reachable from the sandbox.
I compared the two fixes by reading the code only; the effect of option 2 is a prediction.
I did not check documents with both a refund and a delivery, where the refund from the message must stay.
cause: its own model call, no delivery page
whyYou: Every item passes your Accept before any spec or code is written. Size and risk are the agent's reading.
facts: Kind: bug. Size M, risk R1.
Root cause at `app/detector.py:425-432`: the page loop passes the same message with only one page.
Reproduced: `uv run python repro.py` → refund from the message in 3 of 3 runs.
Assumption: the test model stands in for the production model.
